title: laplace.packet-return/1
description: The ONE shape a dispatched build packet returns, for every provider. It merges the shape Codex root settled on in its 2026-10-03/04 rollout (evidence/WRITING_CONSOLIDATION_2026-10-03/resume-codex-20261003/canonical_action-build.json: schema_version, status, goal, inputs with sha256, source branch/commits/candidate/candidate_parent/candidate_tree, validation, repository_effects) with the closure-loop fields the Atlas programme requires (no 'not done' return: a residual is a DEMONSTRATED impossibility carrying the clause it contradicts, the failing command and the smallest change). The worker WRITES this file at the return_path its brief names in section 0; the harness envelope carries only {return_path, summary}, so the exact return is a file on disk with a sha256, not a model's paraphrase in a transcript.

schema_version.description: This schema's $id; the version check-return resolves the validating schema by.

packet.description: The packet label from the plan's agents list, verbatim.

role.description: Which turn of the packet this return is: the first build, a continuation after a rejection, or the wave's synthesis.

status.description: COMPLETE when the brief is met; DEMONSTRATED-IMPOSSIBILITY only when at least one residual carries its failing command and the clause it contradicts.

goal.description: The packet's goal in the plan's own words, so a judge compares the return against what was asked and not against what was done.

inputs.description: Every file the packet was given, each pinned by content so a judge reads the same bytes the builder read.

path.description: Absolute or repository-relative path of the input.

sha256.description: sha256 of the input's bytes as read, bare hex or sha256:-prefixed.

source.description: Where the code is, so the judge checks out the exact candidate instead of reading the live tree.

branch.description: The lane branch the work is committed on; never master and never pushed.

base_commit.description: The commit the lane branched from.

candidate.description: The commit a judge must check out: the final commit of this return.

candidate_parent.description: The candidate's parent, so the judge can diff the lane's last step.

candidate_tree.description: The candidate's tree object id: the content identity of the whole checkout, independent of commit metadata.

worktree.description: Absolute path of the worktree left in place for the judge, or the word removed with where the branch lives.

output.description: Absolute path of the report this return accompanies, the one the plan's output field names.

files_written.description: Every path this packet created or changed, repository-relative; the judge's diff must contain no more than these.

summary.description: What was established, in plain technical English; the only field the harness envelope repeats.

most_important.description: The findings a reader must not miss, ordered; each one a claim, not a topic.

scripted_check.description: The packet's own scripted check as actually run, with its exit code: the acceptance evidence the builder owes before returning.

command.description: The exact command line run, as the plan's check field spells it with <TREE> resolved.

exit_code.description: The process exit status; a non-zero check must be explained by a residual.

output_tail.description: The check's final output, verbatim, enough of it to read the verdict.

profile.description: Optional: a measurement of the organ this packet built, when the packet's brief names a profile entry (distil.py profile).

verdict.description: Inherent work or overhead, in the profiler's own words.

overhead_share.description: Fraction of wall time that was overhead rather than the work itself.

residuals.description: DEMONSTRATED impossibilities only, never a list of what was skipped: empty when status is COMPLETE and non-empty exactly when it is DEMONSTRATED-IMPOSSIBILITY.

clause.description: The sentence of the brief or the line of the tree that the demonstration contradicts.

failing_command.description: The command whose observed output is the demonstration, with its result.

smallest_change.description: The smallest change that would close it, and whose decision it is.
